title: 心理科学専門実験・演習B
subtitle: Psychological Science Major Lab/Exercises B
keywords: Programming 2.Stimulus-Response Relationship 3.Analysis of Variance 4.Measurement of Brain Activity 5.Measurement of Biological Information
educationalGoal: Programming and Psychological Experiment: Students practice writing a program for a psychological experiment using MATLAB and PsychToolBox, run the experiment, and perform analysis of variance with the data obtained in the experiment. Measurement of Brain Activity and Biological Information: Students practice measuring brain activity and biological information with different measurement devices, and analyze the data.
advice: This course is required for Certified Psychologists. In order to reveal the system for processing on Kansei and cognition, it is necessary to measure and analyze not only overt behavioral indices, but also implicit ones like brain and biological activity. In “Programming and Psychological Experiment”, students practice writing a program for a experiment on cognitive psychology using MATLAB and PsychToolBox. In “Measurement of Brain Activity and Biological Information”, students practice experiments to measure brain activity and biological information. Both components include not only experiments, but presentations and writing reports on the experiments. Understanding these methods is important to understand the system for processing on Kansei and cognition, and to prepare for experiments in Design Project III.
books: Textbooks:Psychological Science Major Lab/Exercises B (Kanazawa Institute of Technology) Reference books:None Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: Review thoroughly what you learned in the previous courses on statistics and programming, especially “Programming for Psychology II”. If you have not taken” Programming for Psychology II” yet, tell the lecturer in advance to receive study advice.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand programs for psychological experiments and how to write them.
Ability to analyze behavioral indices like reaction time and error rate properly.
Ability to explain the basic of measuring brain activity and biological information.
Ability to measure brain activity and biological information and analyze the data.
